item.title: Let's make the worst Htmx
item.description:
📝 We also follow HTMX convention and send a custom header to the backend with the request. Note how we propagate event details from one event to another, meaning that event handlers can modify the request and swap flow. My initial impression from HTMX was that it does only one thing: if an event happens on some element with declarative configuration – send an AJAX request to some URL and swap the response into some other element.
🔗 Read more: https://zserge.com/posts/worst-htmx-ever/
